title: WorldTimeSettings
description: Data file content/world/time.json: world time without an earth calendar (counted from the founding of the world). Values are data; day and season length per F5226 (A), other values are placeholders until Marcel decides.

ticks_per_hour.description: Simulation ticks per game hour; must divide or be a multiple of 60.

twilight_minutes.description: Length of dawn and of dusk in game minutes.

seasons.description: Seasons in their fixed cycle, starting with the season of the founding (B2476: four seasons).

normal_real_seconds_per_day.description: Real seconds one game day takes at normal speed.

fast_forward_factors.description: Speed-up factors offered besides normal speed and pause.

max_ticks_per_frame.description: Upper bound of ticks the game advances in one rendered frame.

sunrise_minute.description: Sunrise in game minutes after midnight.

sunset_minute.description: Sunset in game minutes after midnight.
